title: Synthetic grant and invoice evidence acceptance set
test_environment: Offline synthetic award and invoice ledger with exact duplicate, period, evidence, and authority fields.
independent_reviewer_role: Financial-management reviewer independent of the responding system team

cases.failure_shape: A paid line is presented for payment twice.
A similar legitimate line is falsely labeled fraud or rejected.
A one-day boundary error advances an unsupported charge.
The main receipt is present while the required approval is absent.
Evidence preparation silently becomes a payment decision.

sources.title: 2 CFR Part 200 — Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards
sources.selector: Current award requirements and cost principles; accountable officials must identify the applicable award terms and provisions.

sources.title: FAR Subpart 32.9 — Prompt Payment
sources.selector: Prompt-payment policy and invoice handling; verify applicability and current agency procedures.

sources.title: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government
sources.selector: Performance testing, data rights, portability, pricing transparency, and monitoring.
